gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-sulphur-point: Heavy, spaced-out letters, each standing alone. Sulphur Point answers with rounded, marker-like lowercase that stays open, where Impact Label just hits hard and moves on.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-tiktok-sans: Commanding is how Impact Label lands, each letter alone like a bead on a rod. TikTok Sans follows with a tall lowercase that nearly reaches cap height, giving the heavy heading a modern sans underneath.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans reads with big, round lowercase eyes and tubular strokes, like bent copper pipe. And the line never swells or thins, so a long passage would move along smoothly beneath Impact Label.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-vend-sans: Impact Label stands heavy and commanding, each letter set apart like a bead on a rod. And Vend Sans brings ruler-straight, unshaded lines with an x-height that fills the line, which is the pair's plainest strength.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-yaldevi: Each Impact Label letter sits alone, like a bead on a rod. Yaldevi brings outsized lowercase with an e that opens clearly to the right, and that clean, roomy openness is the strongest quality against the heavy heading.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-abeezee: Jelly Crazies has bowls that nearly seal shut, wobbly and playful without any calligraphic thinning in the line. ABeeZee stays open, with terminals clear of the stem.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-aldrich: Jelly Crazies wobbles along with no calligraphic thinning, its bowls nearly sealed. Aldrich has an x-height close to cap height, so it can go slightly smaller than the heading without losing presence.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-alexandria: Jelly Crazies has bowls that nearly seal shut. Alexandria stays open, with wide c terminals and a tall body, so a long stretch of text moves along clearly and without crowding.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-amiko: Jelly Crazies wobbles with playful, nearly closed bowls and no thinning in its line, a heading that slows reading to a leisurely walk. Amiko does the opposite job, with tall lowercase strokes and terminals pointing outward like a pair of tongs.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-anek-bangla: Playful is the first word for Jelly Crazies, with its wobbly marker-like line and nearly closed bowls. Anek Bangla sits quietly alongside with wide, barely curled s curves and a short stretch from midline to ascender.
